limitations: The corridor tests walks only, not jumps or powered crossings.
Smooth-world unit checks demonstrate timely positive delivery; this physical corpus supplies no successful extended walk.
The selected blocked walking replay fails the world capsule at node 388 after 113 visited nodes; the selected armed replay fails the parked-vehicle hull at node 268 after seven.
Failure of this one short-arc hypothesis is not a proof that all routes to its flag are impossible.
Cover search still waits on its first unknown candidate until deadline rather than advancing on completed walking hypotheses.
The complete fallback still finishes no candidates or powered forecasts in these runs.
Both planners use the new option in armed matches; two generated worlds and seat swaps are a small correlated sample.
Repeated publications are not independent routes or physical captures.
Synchronous work is outside dispatch quotas; no Pi performance claim.
